description.en: Standalone quick panel for DSH: todos, reminders, live session view and quick input. After installing, press ⌘Q (Command + Q) to quit DSH completely and reopen it; a refresh is not enough.
description.zh: DSH 快捷面板（macOS 版）：待办、提醒、实时消息和快速输入。安装后请按 ⌘Q（Command + Q）完全退出 DSH 并重新打开；仅刷新页面不够。

description.en: A standalone DSH companion window with todos, reminders, live messages, approvals and quick input. After installing, press ⌘Q (Command + Q) to quit DSH completely and reopen it; a refresh is not enough.
description.zh: macOS 上的 DSH 独立伴生窗：待办、提醒、实时消息、审批和快速输入。安装后请按 ⌘Q（Command + Q）完全退出 DSH 并重新打开；仅刷新页面不够。
